summary: First iteration. Backend (20 pytest tests) all pass for AgriMart e-commerce APIs. Frontend e2e: home/shop/PDP/register/cart/account/admin all working. Place-order from /checkout did not navigate to /order-confirmed in the playwright run; needs E1 verification of address-field data-testids vs Checkout.jsx field selectors.

integration_issues.issue: After filling address form (using data-testids addr-fullname/addr-phone/addr-line1/addr-city/addr-state/addr-pincode) and clicking [data-testid='place-order-btn'], URL stayed on /checkout instead of /order-confirmed/:id. Need to verify exact data-testid names on Checkout.jsx address inputs (some may be missing or named differently) OR there is a client-side validation/error preventing submission. Backend POST /api/orders works perfectly via API tests.

action_items: Verify Checkout.jsx address input data-testids match the expected pattern (addr-fullname etc.) and that place-order-btn correctly triggers POST /api/orders and navigates on success. If testids differ, either rename to match contract or update spec; ensure error toast is shown on validation failure.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — should migrate to lifespan handlers (FastAPI >=0.93).
CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router; ordering is fine in Starlette but better added before routes for clarity.
GET /api/cart and POST /api/orders re-fetch each product in a loop (N+1 query). Consider $in batch fetch.
ONLINE payments are demo-only and immediately marked 'paid' — clearly disclosed as MOCKED per spec.
JWT_SECRET read via os.environ['JWT_SECRET'] — good, no default. ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD also required env vars (good).
Password hashing uses bcrypt $2b$ — verified. Admin re-seed updates password if env changes (good).
test_credentials: Admin admin@agrimart.com / Admin@123. Customer accounts created during tests with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Test users with TEST_ prefix and one TEST_PROD_* product (deleted in same test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_agrimart_api.py — 20/20 pass. Frontend home/shop/PDP/register/login/cart/account/admin all work. Only checkout->order-confirmed navigation needs revisiting. data-testids verified on home/shop/PDP/admin pages; need to verify address-field testids on /checkout.
rca_of_the_issue: Place-order failure RCA pending: either (a) address input data-testids in Checkout.jsx don't match addr-fullname/addr-phone/addr-line1/addr-city/addr-state/addr-pincode (so fields stayed empty -> validation blocked submit), or (b) onSuccess handler doesn't navigate. Backend POST /api/orders verified working via pytest. Recommend: open Checkout.jsx and confirm input data-testids; ensure handleSubmit catches errors and navigates on success.
